effectSummary.ko: 8m 안의 반경 3m에 소용돌이를 4초간 만듭니다. 생성 시 최대 5명을 중심으로 1.5m 끌어오고, 1초마다 D30% 번개 피해를 줍니다. 최대 1개이며 보스는 이동하지 않고 제압 수치만 얻습니다.
effectSummary.en: Create a 3m vortex within 8m for 4s. On creation, pull up to 5 enemies 1.5m toward the center; deal D30% lightning damage each second. Limit 1. Bosses receive stagger credit without moving.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: HELLSCRIPT Mage skill icon, M16 Magnetic Vortex / 자력 소용돌이, active.
Primary request: Create ONE original independent 1024x1024 PNG icon with REAL NATIVE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. A compact rotating dark magnetic vortex with three thick hooked blue-violet spiral arms dragging three angular iron fragments inward. One sharp lightning seam shines through the dense center. Convey an active pulling hazard with rotation and force, different from calm blue mana charging. No ground.
Effect context: Create a 3m vortex within 8m for 4s. On creation, pull up to 5 enemies 1.5m toward the center; deal D30% lightning damage each second. Limit 1. Bosses receive stagger credit without moving.
Relevant equipment linkage: DES_LM45. Match the effect rather than copying existing item art.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy game art, sculptural large shapes, restrained tactile brush texture, somber charcoal shadows, weathered materials where relevant, pale high-contrast edges, selective saturated magic. Two or three major forms, minimal tiny particles. Legible and individually recognizable at 64px.
Composition: centered cohesive isolated subject, every visible shape and glow fully inside the central 76 percent of the square canvas; at least 12 percent completely transparent padding on all four sides. Only the depicted skill, no surrounding scene.
Output: exactly 1024x1024 PNG with native RGBA alpha. All surrounding and internal empty space truly transparent. Preserve clean antialiased alpha edges, no opaque matte or halo.
Avoid: any background or solid backdrop, checkerboard picture, floor, ground, cast shadow, stand, UI panel, frame, border, lettering, written runes, digits, ID labels, logo or watermark. Do not copy or recolor an existing icon.

readability64.ko: 철 조각을 끌어오는 세 회전 날개가 자력 소용돌이를 드러냅니다.
readability64.en: Three rotating arms drawing iron fragments inward identify magnetic pull.

edges.ko: 원본과 밝은·어두운 바탕의 256px 검수에서 불투명 매트, 배경 무늬, 잘린 주형태를 발견하지 못했습니다. 가장자리의 매우 낮은 알파 픽셀은 자동 경고로 남깁니다.
edges.en: Native output and 256px light/dark inspection showed no opaque matte, backdrop pattern or clipped main form. Very low-alpha border pixels remain recorded warnings.

distinctness.en: The major silhouette and effect remain distinct among this production group in the actual64px contact sheets.
